companyInfo.Footnote: Paramount Global and Skydance Media, LLC merged became subsidiaries of holding company, Paramount Skydance, Aug. 7, 2025. Paramount Global is deemed the predecessor company. Market value as of March 31, 2026.

description: Paramount Global organizes its vast media portfolio into three main divisions: TV media, direct-to-consumer (streaming), and filmed entertainment, which includes the iconic Paramount Pictures studio. Its television assets span CBS and cable networks like Comedy Central, MTV, Showtime, and BET. The company also operates and licenses its content internationally. In 2024, Skydance Media announced an $8 billion deal to acquire Paramount by first purchasing parent company National Amusements. The two-part transaction is expected to close in 2025, pending regulatory approval.

title: Paramount Skydance

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: This company epitomizes Hollywood's fast-shifting corporate landscape. It was formed last August when Skydance, founded by David Ellison, merged with Paramount, owner of CBS and movie IP like the Mission: Impossible franchise. It will morph further this year as it completes the acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery.

rankings.itemDescription: ViacomCBS was formed in 2019 when CBS and Viacom merged—13 years after breaking apart. Today the mass media conglomerate operates more than 170 networks reaching 700 million subscribers worldwide. As of the first quarter of 2021, the company had some 36 million paid streaming subscribers for its Paramount+ and Showtime offerings.

rankings.itemDescription: The reunited CBS and Viacom completed their merger in December and had a strong year, with hits like The Late Show With Stephen Colbert helping to drive $28 billion in sales.
